# DonorDock Pricing

DonorDock offers simple, transparent pricing for nonprofits:

## Pricing Tiers

**Free Plan**
- $0/month
- Up to 500 contacts
- Basic donor management features
- Email support

**Growth Plan**
- $39/month (billed annually) or $49/month (billed monthly)
- Up to 2,500 contacts
- All core features including:
  - Donation tracking
  - Email campaigns
  - Tasks and automation
  - Custom fields
  - Reports and analytics

**Pro Plan**
- $79/month (billed annually) or $99/month (billed monthly)
- Up to 10,000 contacts
- Everything in Growth, plus:
  - Advanced automations
  - Priority support
  - Enhanced reporting

**Enterprise Plan**
- Custom pricing
- 10,000+ contacts
- Dedicated account manager
- Custom integrations
- White-glove onboarding

## Key Features
- No setup fees
- No contracts (month-to-month available)
- No transaction fees on donations
- 14-day free trial available

**Note:** Pricing may have changed since my last update. I recommend visiting [DonorDock's official pricing page](https://www.donordock.com/pricing) or contacting their sales team directly for the most current pricing information and to discuss which plan fits your organization's needs.
